input.file_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Metropolitan Museum Inventory TSV Standardization Script This script performs data quality transformations on the Met inventory TSV file. Includes checksums for verification of transformations. """ import sys import hashlib from pathlib import Path import csv from io import StringIO import re import html def calculate_checksum(filepath, algorithm='sha256'): """Calculate file checksum.""" hash_obj = hashlib.new(algorithm) with open(filepath, 'rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(4096), b''): hash_obj.update(chunk) return hash_obj.hexdigest() def calculate_content_checksum(content, algorithm='sha256'): """Calculate checksum of string content.""" hash_obj = hashlib.new(algorithm) hash_obj.update(content.encode('utf-8')) return hash_obj.hexdigest() def normalize_html_entities(text): """Convert HTML entities to plain text.""" if not text: return text # Handle common HTML entities and tags text = html.unescape(text) text = re.sub(r'(.*?)', r'\1', text) text = re.sub(r'(.*?)', r'\1', text) text = re.sub(r']+>', '', text) # Remove any remaining tags return text def clean_title(title): """Clean and normalize title field.""" if not title or title.strip() == '': return '' title = title.strip() # Remove leading/trailing brackets used for uncertain data title = re.sub(r'^\[|\]$', '', title) # Normalize HTML entities title = normalize_html_entities(title) # Clean up extra quotes title = re.sub(r'"{2,}', '"', title) return title def clean_field(field): """General field cleaning.""" if field is None: return '' field = field.strip() return field def standardize_row(row): """Standardize a single row.""" # Ensure we have 4 columns while len(row) < 4: row.append('') row = row[:4] # Take only first 4 columns # Apply cleaning row[0] = clean_field(row[0]) # Object Date row[1] = clean_title(row[1]) # Title row[2] = clean_field(row[2]) # Object Number row[3] = clean_field(row[3]) # Link Resource return row def standardize_file(input_path, output_path): """Main standardization function.""" # Print header print("=" * 80) print("Met Inventory TSV Standardization") print("=" * 80) print() # Calculate input checksum input_checksum = calculate_checksum(input_path) print(f"Input file: {input_path}") print(f"Input checksum (SHA256): {input_checksum}") print() # Read file with various encodings content = None for encoding in ['utf-8', 'utf-8-sig', 'latin-1']: try: with open(input_path, 'r', encoding=encoding) as f: content = f.read() print(f"Successfully read file with encoding: {encoding}") break except UnicodeDecodeError: continue if content is None: print("ERROR: Could not read file with any encoding") sys.exit(1) print() # Parse TSV input_reader = csv.reader(StringIO(content), delimiter='\t') rows = list(input_reader) print(f"Total rows read: {len(rows)}") print(f" - Header row: 1") print(f" - Data rows: {len(rows) - 1}") print() # Check header header = rows[0] print(f"Header columns: {len(header)}") print(f"Header: {header}") print() # Standardize data rows standardized_rows = [header] # Keep header as-is transformation_stats = { 'rows_processed': 0, 'titles_cleaned': 0, 'empty_titles_removed': 0, 'html_entities_removed': 0, 'fields_trimmed': 0, } for i, row in enumerate(rows[1:], start=1): original_row = row.copy() standardized_row = standardize_row(row) # Track transformations transformation_stats['rows_processed'] += 1 if clean_title(original_row[1] if len(original_row) > 1 else '') != (standardized_row[1] or ''): transformation_stats['titles_cleaned'] += 1 if '<' in str(original_row) and '<' not in str(standardized_row): transformation_stats['html_entities_removed'] += 1 for j in range(4): if len(original_row) > j and original_row[j] != standardized_row[j]: transformation_stats['fields_trimmed'] += 1 standardized_rows.append(standardized_row) # Write standardized file output_content = StringIO() writer = csv.writer(output_content, delimiter='\t', lineterminator='\n') writer.writerows(standardized_rows) output_str = output_content.getvalue() # Write to file with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(output_str) # Calculate output checksum output_checksum = calculate_checksum(output_path) output_content_checksum = calculate_content_checksum(output_str) print("Transformation Statistics:") print(f" - Rows processed: {transformation_stats['rows_processed']}") print(f" - Titles cleaned: {transformation_stats['titles_cleaned']}") print(f" - HTML entities removed: {transformation_stats['html_entities_removed']}") print(f" - Fields trimmed: {transformation_stats['fields_trimmed']}") print() print(f"Output file: {output_path}") print(f"Output checksum (SHA256): {output_checksum}") print(f"Output content checksum (SHA256): {output_content_checksum}") print() print(f"Input file size: {Path(input_path).stat().st_size} bytes") print(f"Output file size: {Path(output_path).stat().st_size} bytes") print() # Generate verification report verification_report = { 'input_file': str(input_path), 'input_checksum_sha256': input_checksum, 'output_file': str(output_path), 'output_checksum_sha256': output_checksum, 'output_content_checksum_sha256': output_content_checksum, 'input_file_size': Path(input_path).stat().st_size, 'output_file_size': Path(output_path).stat().st_size, 'rows_input': len(rows), 'rows_output': len(standardized_rows), 'transformation_stats': transformation_stats, } return verification_report if __name__ == '__main__': if len(sys.argv) < 2: print("Usage: python3 standardize_met_inventory.py [output_file]") print("Example: python3 standardize_met_inventory.py met_inventory_original.tsv met_inventory_standardized.tsv") sys.exit(1) input_file = sys.argv[1] output_file = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'met_inventory_standardized.tsv' verification = standardize_file(input_file, output_file) # Write verification report report_file = output_file.replace('.tsv', '_verification.txt') with open(report_file, 'w') as f: f.write("STANDARDIZATION VERIFICATION REPORT\n") f.write("=" * 80 + "\n\n") f.write(f"Input File: {verification['input_file']}\n") f.write(f"Input Checksum (SHA256): {verification['input_checksum_sha256']}\n") f.write(f"Input File Size: {verification['input_file_size']} bytes\n") f.write(f"Input Rows: {verification['rows_input']}\n\n") f.write(f"Output File: {verification['output_file']}\n") f.write(f"Output Checksum (SHA256): {verification['output_checksum_sha256']}\n") f.write(f"Output Content Checksum (SHA256): {verification['output_content_checksum_sha256']}\n") f.write(f"Output File Size: {verification['output_file_size']} bytes\n") f.write(f"Output Rows: {verification['rows_output']}\n\n") f.write("Transformation Statistics:\n") for key, value in verification['transformation_stats'].items(): f.write(f" - {key}: {value}\n") print(f"Verification report written to: {report_file}") print("=" * 80)
